2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgments and orders dated 05.10.1994 and 02.08.1995.

The Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offences), Hathras Junction vide judgment and order dated 05.10.1994 convicted Revisionist and sentenced him to six months rigorous imprisonment under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as ?Act, 1954?) with fine Rs.1000/- and in default in payment of fine, he was further to undergo three months rigorous imprisonment.
